originalImportProvenance.sourceToApprovedIdleQuatRebase: offset = approved_target_idle * inverse(mapped_source_idle); output = offset * mapped_source_pose
originalImportProvenance.pelvisTransfer: source hip world-space delta added to approved target hip, with a single global translation, without per-foot world-space lock
originalImportProvenance.glbRotations: LINEAR interpolation at sampled source action frames

cautions: Historic script explicitly evaluated source IK; merely changing the Lionheart file format does not repair geometry-dependent retarget error.
The source and target may have different rest poses; local rotations matching do not establish equal world-space foot placement.
This index is repository archaeology, not evidence that any past visual report was accepted.
